target: Sparse (PATO_0001609) and increased amount (copious) should both sit under amount or density.

Oblique or reflexed sepals are alternative orientations or positions of the same part. Both groundings fit.

target: Make straw yellow (PATO_0104343) a subclass of yellow or color, alongside brown.
reason: Both are seed colours. The pair should be a union under color.

target: Put frutescent habit and semi-woody under a common woodiness or habit class.
reason: Suffrutescent and fruticose are degrees of woodiness of one plant.

Oblique is the angle of the tertiary veins. Reticulate is the pattern of the network. These are different characters.

target: Make capitate and saucer-shaped subclasses of shape (PATO_0000052), or of a common stigma-shape class.
reason: Dish-shaped or capitate stigma are alternative shapes of one organ.
Valvate and open are the two classic aestivation types. They are alternatives of one botanical character.
'Intricate' is a single word grounded as two values. It is not an 'A or B'.

target: Put cyme-like and corymb-like under a common inflorescence-form parent.
reason: Cymiform or corymbiform arrays are alternative values of one character.

Gray or canescent foliage are alternative descriptions of the grey appearance of the foliage, one by colour and one by indumentum.

target: Place wiry and inflexible under flexibility, with wiry below inflexible.
reason: Stiff or wiry are two degrees of one flexibility character.

Opposite or irregular phyllotaxis are alternative leaf arrangements. Irregular spatial pattern fits 'irregularly arranged'.
